# Sound-port sequences for the reference recordings (DESIGN §14.5), read by
# scripts/mame/sounds.lua (MAME) and by the synth's tests (our emulator).
#
#   sound <name> <frames>     a sequence and its length in frames
#   <frame> <port> <value>    write value to port at the end of that frame
#
# Frames are MAME's video frames, 59.54 per second (DESIGN §8). The game writes
# no sound ports in attract mode, so these writes play each sound on its own.
# Port 3 bit 5 (0x20) is the amplifier: it goes on at frame 120, after MAME's
# power-on transient has settled, and stays on.

# Shot: port 3 bit 1. The game holds the bit while the shot flies.
sound shot 300
120 3 0x20
150 3 0x22
180 3 0x20

# Player dies: port 3 bit 2.
sound playerdies 420
120 3 0x20
150 3 0x24
210 3 0x20

# Invader dies: port 3 bit 3.
sound invaderdies 300
120 3 0x20
150 3 0x28
160 3 0x20

# Extended play (bonus life): port 3 bit 4, a tone while held.
sound extendedplay 330
120 3 0x20
150 3 0x30
240 3 0x20

# UFO: port 3 bit 0, while held.
sound ufo 420
120 3 0x20
150 3 0x21
330 3 0x20

# Fleet notes 1-4: port 5 bits 0-3, each held 4 frames, as the game does.
sound fleet 400
120 3 0x20
150 5 0x01
154 5 0x00
200 5 0x02
204 5 0x00
250 5 0x04
254 5 0x00
300 5 0x08
304 5 0x00

# UFO hit: port 5 bit 4.
sound ufohit 330
120 3 0x20
150 5 0x10
210 5 0x00
